This webinar will examine how AI is influencing the skills required of health professionals, transforming workforce deployment and decision-making and shaping national and global health labour markets. epidemiology.title: Intellectual Property and Traditional Medicine: Rethinking Access, Benefit Sharing and Data Governance - World Health Organization (WHO)
epidemiology.summary: Recent developments in the international intellectual property landscape—including the WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge, ongoing IGC negotiations, and broader discussions on access and benefit sharing and digital governance—highlight the need to examine their implications for traditional medicine. As traditional medicine knowledge becomes increasingly digitized and utilized through research, artificial intelligence and innovation ecosystems, new policy questions arise regarding equitable benefit sharing, governance of traditional medicine data, and the recognition of Indigenous Peoples and local communities as rights holders in the stewardship and governance of their knowledge systems. This side event aims to facilitate dialogue on these emerging issues and identify considerations for future international cooperation.Register to watch online.
